problem.passage:
In the figure, line $m$ and line $n$ are parallel. Line $k$ is a transversal that crosses line $m$ at point $A$ and crosses line $n$ at point $B$. Line $j$ is a transversal that crosses line $n$ at point $C$ and crosses line $k$ at point $E$, where $E$ lies below line $n$. Points $A$, $B$, and $C$ all lie above point $E$, so lines $k$ and $j$ together with line $n$ form triangle $BEC$, with vertex $B$ on line $n$ where line $k$ crosses it, vertex $C$ on line $n$ where line $j$ crosses it, and vertex $E$ below line $n$ where lines $k$ and $j$ intersect. The angle formed at $A$ by line $m$ and line $k$, on the right side of line $k$ and above line $m$, measures $37°$. This angle is positioned identically (corresponding angle) to the angle at $B$ formed by line $n$ and line $k$ on the right side of line $k$ and above line $n$. The interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $B$ is vertical to that corresponding angle at $B$, so it also measures $37°$. The angle formed at $C$ by line $n$ and line $j$, on the left side of line $j$ and above line $n$, measures $z°$; this angle is vertical to the interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $C$, so that interior angle also measures $z°$. The interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $E$ measures $x°$. If $z = 78$, what is the value of $x$?

What is the value of $x$?
problem.stimulus: In the figure, line $m$ and line $n$ are parallel. Line $k$ is a transversal that crosses line $m$ at point $A$ and crosses line $n$ at point $B$. Line $j$ is a transversal that crosses line $n$ at point $C$ and crosses line $k$ at point $E$, where $E$ lies below line $n$. Points $A$, $B$, and $C$ all lie above point $E$, so lines $k$ and $j$ together with line $n$ form triangle $BEC$, with vertex $B$ on line $n$ where line $k$ crosses it, vertex $C$ on line $n$ where line $j$ crosses it, and vertex $E$ below line $n$ where lines $k$ and $j$ intersect. The angle formed at $A$ by line $m$ and line $k$, on the right side of line $k$ and above line $m$, measures $37°$. This angle is positioned identically (corresponding angle) to the angle at $B$ formed by line $n$ and line $k$ on the right side of line $k$ and above line $n$. The interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $B$ is vertical to that corresponding angle at $B$, so it also measures $37°$. The angle formed at $C$ by line $n$ and line $j$, on the left side of line $j$ and above line $n$, measures $z°$; this angle is vertical to the interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $C$, so that interior angle also measures $z°$. The interior angle of triangle $BEC$ at vertex $E$ measures $x°$. If $z = 78$, what is the value of $x$?
problem.question: What is the value of $x$?
problem.explanation: 선 m과 n이 평행하고 k가 횡단선이므로, A에서 생긴 37° 각(선 m의 오른쪽 위)은 B에서 선 n과 k가 이루는 각 중 같은 위치(동위각)와 같아서 37°이다. 이 동위각은 삼각형 BEC의 꼭짓점 B에서의 내각과 맞꼭지각 관계이므로, 삼각형의 내각도 37°이다. 마찬가지로 C에서 z=78° 각은 삼각형 BEC의 꼭짓점 C에서의 내각과 맞꼭지각 관계이므로 그 내각도 78°이다. 삼각형의 세 내각의 합은 180°이므로, x = 180 - 37 - 78 = 65. 따라서 x = 65. (만약 맞꼭지각 관계를 놓치고 z를 그대로 외각으로 착각해 78 - 37 = 41로 계산하면 오답이 나오므로, 각 위치와 맞꼭지각/동위각 관계를 정확히 확인해야 한다.)

difficultyReasons: 평행선-횡단선의 대응각과 맞꼭지각 관계를 두 번 적용해 삼각형 내각을 구해야 함
삼각형 내각의 합이 180도임을 마지막에 적용하는 2단계 추론 필요
도형을 정확히 해석해야 각 B, C가 37°, 78°임을 알 수 있음
